source_evidence_checksum_manifest.note: The current manifest declares 1411 evidence entries. An earlier Phase 2B report stated 1410; this sidecar records the count observed in the current source manifest.

recovered_field.timestamp_semantics: First client-originated IPv4 SYN to the configured server endpoint, as observed in the captured PCAP.
recovered_field.attribution_scope: Family-wide first SYN. This is not asserted to be the SYN of the primary navigation TCP stream.

supplemental_validation.description: Additional checks not present in the original dry-run. They do not alter the original six-category result.
supplemental_validation.analyzer_timestamp_rule: Recovered IPv4 attempt timestamp must be numeric, finite, non-negative, and not precede the earliest valid positive target-host A response timestamp.
supplemental_validation.frame_order_rule: When family first-SYN timestamps are equal, frame numbers are preserved to expose packet order separately.
